issue_context.title: Command line sensor with date device class raise str object has no attribute isoformat
issue_context.body:
### The problem

I want to use an open data to get electricity prices. Desired value is the last update date, prices are state attributes.
To get these data I use a Python script which get the date and price and run it using a command line sensor.
But it is not possible to set device class to date even if the value is a date in ISO format.

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2023.7.3

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Core

### Integration causing the issue

Command line sensor

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/command_line

### Diagnostics information

_No response_

### Example YAML snippet

```yaml
command_line:
- sensor:
    name: "Tarif réglementé base"
    unique_id: "tarif_reglemente_base_api"
    scan_interval: 86400
    value_template: "{{ strptime(value_json.LAST_UPDATE, '%d/%m/%Y') }}"
    device_class: "date"
    json_attributes:
    - PART_FIXE_TTC
    - PART_VARIABLE_BASE_TTC
    command: "python3 /home/homeassistant/bin/tarif_reglemente.py"
```

### Additional information

The Python script to get data:

```python
import requests
import csv

url = "https://www.data.gouv.fr/fr/datasets/r/c13d05e5-9e55-4d03-bf7e-042a2ade7e49" # BASE
P_SOUSCRITE = "9"

with requests.get(url, stream = True) as r:
    cr = csv.reader(r.content.decode('utf-8').splitlines(), delimiter=';')
    my_list = list(cr)

    for row in my_list: 
        if row[1] == '' and row[2] == P_SOUSCRITE:
            print('{"LAST_UPDATE": "'+row[0]+'","PART_FIXE_TTC": '+row[4].replace(",", "." )+',"PART_VARIABLE_BASE_TTC": '+row[6].replace(",", "." )+'}')
```
